messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — compliance needs an "access evidence" bundle for Q1 access review. We have gaps: KMS key owners unclear for project-redwood-east, and ~8 admin roles flagged with no owner. Need: current ACL exports, last 90 days of KMS key access logs, and justification for any admin role left >30d without owner. Deadline EOD Thu.

raj: on it. which format do they want? zip w/ CSVs + signed hash?

maria: zip with CSVs is fine. They want a signed SHA256 hash and an internal manifest. Upload to secure-bucket and share pre-signed link. See spec: https://go/reports/access-evidence-v2

cleo: I can export KMS logs — running:```bash
gcloud logging read "resource.type=cloudkms_crypto_key AND protoPayload.methodName:Encrypt" --project=redwood-east --limit=5000 --format=json > kms-access-90d.json
```will scrub emails before share.

jamie: note: include SEC-4321 mitigation notes (april leaked admin key). compliance expects a short incident summary + link to remediation ticket. Also re-check svcacct@analytics owner tag — looks stale.

sec-bot: Automated entitlement scan: found 8 roles with no owner: admin, infra-lead, db-admin, deploy-admin, billing-admin, kms-root, metrics-admin, secrets-admin. (scan id: sb-2026-04-08-07)

raj: I'll run entitlement-scan and attach output. Command:```bash
./tools/entitlement-scan --project=redwood-east --since=90d --format=csv > entitlements-redwood-east.csv
```Also will pull IAM bindings:```bash
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-east --format=json > iam-bindings.json
```

maria: @raj please also add mapping to KMS key policy: show bindings that grant roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter and roles/cloudkms.admin. We need explicit principal -> key mapping.

cleo: remember to redact user emails for external bundle per policy. Replace with anonymized IDs and include a mapping only in internal package. Retention note: archive store has logs >180d; we only need last 90d for this review.

maria: proposing interim owners so compliance can close the loop: @helen for kms-root, @sam for db-admin, @kevin for deploy-admin. Helen, can you ack ownership and confirm permissions are scoped?

helen: ack. I'll take kms-root. I'll run a quick ownerless-key check and propose retirement for keys with zero recent usage.

sam: I'll triage db-admin and open JustifiedAccess tickets for long-lived grants, tagging with SEC-4321 where relevant.

kevin: deploy-admin ack. Will verify CI service accounts and make sure no human user holds deploy-admin.

maria: packaging requirements: 1) entitlements CSV, 2) IAM bindings JSON, 3) kms-access-90d.json (redacted), 4) incident summary for SEC-4321, 5) owner assignment sheet, 6) manifest.json with SHA256. Upload to gs://redwood-compliance-evidence/<team>/q1-2026/ and share link. Timeline: collect by EOD Thu, package + hash Fri 09:00, deliver to compliance Fri 12:00. Ping here if blocked. :pray:

raj: seen, starting exports now. Will paste interim links once uploaded to internal bucket.

cleo: FYI quick query shows 3 keys with "externalRotation": false; I'll include a rotation posture note in the bundle.

sec-bot: Reminder: KMS audit logs include plaintext requesterEmail for 90 days. Ensure redaction before any external delivery. Automate redaction script available at tools/redact-logs.py.

maria: perfect. if anyone hits permissions gaps for reading logs, DM me and I'll escalate to infra. Thanks all.
